captions.detailed: An industrial machine-tending robotic arm featuring a dark gray cylindrical pedestal base and a matching tall shoulder fork. A thick, bright orange main arm link extends forward, connected at its end to a slimmer light gray forearm link. The arm terminates in a compact, black and silver cylindrical wrist tool nose. The shoulder and elbow joints enable parallel vertical rotation, while the wrist acts as an independent rotational tool axis.
captions.instruction: Design a realistic machine-tending robotic arm in CadQuery. It should feature a dark gray pedestal base and a tall shoulder fork, a deep orange primary link, a slimmer light gray secondary link, and a black cylindrical wrist nose, ensuring clear, non-overlapping articulation at each joint.
captions.factory: Construct a multi-link assembly starting with a base pedestal from cylinders. Build a tall, blocky shoulder fork using box primitives. Create the primary arm link as a thick orange box with rounded cylinder joints. Form the secondary link with a smaller gray box and a terminal cylindrical wrist nose. Connect each sequential part via revolute joint transformations that establish the correct local coordinate frames.
